sloka: इत्युक्त्वा व्यवमुच्याङ्गाद्भूषणानि महायशाः ।स बबन्ध महार्हाणि तदाङ्गदहनूमतोः ।। ७.३९.१९ ॥
transliteration: ityuktvā vyavamucyāṅgādbhūṣaṇāni mahāyaśāḥ ।sa babandha mahārhāṇi tadāṅgadahanūmatoḥ ।। 7.39.19 ॥

translations.english: Having spoken thus, the greatly renowned Rama then removed valuable ornaments from his own body and fastened them upon Angada and Hanuman.
